title: Arabic Hate Speech Identification and Masking in Social Media using Deep Learning Models and Pre-trained Models Fine-tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of NLP models (specifically RNNs, CNNs, and Transformers like AraBERT) for detecting and masking hate speech in Arabic. While it defines hate speech to include religious intolerance and cites studies on religious hate speech, the core research component is a classification and machine translation task; it does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, theological systems, or ethical frameworks themselves.
